sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 528 Bnss No. - 20622 of 2025
Applicant :- Mohd Irshad And Another

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Mo. Saif,Qaisar Kamal Ansari
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.
1.
Heard Mr. Mohd. Saif, learned counsel for the applicants as well as Sri S.K. Singh, learned AGA for the State.

2.This is an application U/s 528 BNSS filed for quashing the non-bailable-warrant dated 28.02.2020 passed by ACJM, court no.6, Allahabad in complaint case no. 2962 of 2005 (Fazil vs.
Irshad and Ors) U/s 498A, 306 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Sarai Memrej, District Allahabad.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that proceedings U/s 156 (3) Cr.P.C. was lodged on 22.12.2015 against the applicants with an allegation that the marriage of daughter of opposite party no.2 solemnized with Mohd. Irshad.
However constant demand of dowry was being made and on account of the pressure so exerted, she committed suicide on 23.09.2005.

Learned counsel for the applicants submits that a final report came to be submitted against the applicants thereafter, a protest petition came to be filed and post recording of statements U/s 200 & 202 Cr.P.C., the Mohd Irshad And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 5 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/66836635/
1 applicants have been summoned under section 498A IPC read with Section 3/4 D.P. Act.

entities.text: Mohd Irshad And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that even the complainant had also expired and the applicant have no knowledge.
However, non-bailable warrants have been issued on 28.02.2020.
Learned counsel for the applicants on his instructions submits that applicants shall be filing their recall application and till the recall application is decided, protection be accorded.
Learned AGA has no objection to the same.

Considering the submissions so made across the bar, the present application is disposed of directing the applicants to submit a recall application before the court below by 20.06.2025 and on the said motion, subject to the compliance which are necessarily to be made by the applicants, the court below shall decide the same strictly in accordance with law with most expedition.

Till the disposal of the recall application, no coercive action in the proceeding of the non-bailable-warrant dated 28.02.2020 passed by ACJM, court no.6, Allahabad in complaint case no. 2962 of 2005 (Fazil vs. Irshad and Ors) U/s 498A, 306 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Sarai Memrej, District Allahabad.
